intent: The memory of the Hypernormal site's look, as an app. State is exactly {entries: [{seq, at, look: {mode, accent, radius}}]}, oldest first, capped at 200 entries (oldest dropped). Each entry is a snapshot of the look app's state after one change: seq is that change's number from the look app, at is when this app recorded it (ms epoch), look holds the same enums the look app uses (mode light|dark; accent indigo|green|orange|violet|red|teal; radius sharp|soft|round). Recording is public and idempotent: record refuses a seq it has already stored, so any number of watching pages can report the same change and it lands exactly once. A fresh mint starts at {entries: []}. Good faces over this app: a timeline (entries newest first, with time and a color swatch) or stats (counts per accent, per mode, total changes). This app never changes the look; it only remembers it.

record.description: Record one look-change snapshot. Refused (recorded: false) if this seq is already stored, so duplicate reports are harmless.
record.code: const e = ctx.state.entries = ctx.state.entries ?? []; if (e.some(function (x) { return x.seq === ctx.input.seq; })) return { recorded: false, count: e.length }; e.push({ seq: ctx.input.seq, at: ctx.now, look: ctx.input.look }); while (e.length > 200) e.shift(); return { recorded: true, count: e.length };
